predict.question: In B, two new people per trainer, three rounds, capped at 12 people including the original. What is B’s toy result?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: High Output Management treats training as a managerial activity with leverage beyond the manager’s own direct work.
modelBoundary: A reaches {A} people; B reaches {B}. Newly trained people each teach two more, so new layers add 2, 4, then 5 before the 12-person cap. A collision-free teaching tree is stipulated; reach is not learning or workplace performance.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
